title: Account
description: One named party the venture keeps a record for, at accounts/<id>/account.json inside the venture that serves it (EE-011, EE-021). Optional: only ventures that work per party need accounts; who a product serves in general is its market. Account follows CRM usage (an organization or person you have a relationship with). Not a venture: it has no phase or core.

relationship.description: How the venture stands to this party (EE-021). client: served under a professional relationship; customer: buys; user: uses, may not pay; member: belongs (a club, community or cooperative); partner: works with the venture; other: say which in the note

products.description: Ids of the venture's products this account buys or uses

layers.description: Optional: where this account's knowledge and execution records live
